x: New member Jim Preston made a sparkling debut in winning both his hurdle races and Reg. Hopkins confirmed that he was in good shape by being our highest points scorer of the match.
Jim Preston suffering from "the night before" did not enjoy his 400m hurdles at all but by the time his high hurdles race came up he had recovered to give us one of our few wins.

Paul Whitby and James Preston gave us maximum points in the high hurdles while Cliff Brooks broke new ground with a 52 metre javelin throw and succeeded in making Peter Crosbie a winning 'B' man for the day.
